Graduate programs

Master of Applied Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering (MASc)

A thesis-based research degree. Normal length: 24 months, full time. Part-time study by permission of the department.

Admit terms: Fall and Winter. Delivery: in person, main campus.

Admission

  • Four-year bachelor degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum B+ standing in the final two years.
  • English: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with no band below 6.5, or an exemption listed in the calendar.
  • Documents: transcripts, two references, statement of interest, CV. Application fee: FCU 120.

Deadlines

Fall intake: 15 January. Winter intake: 15 August.

Supervision

Contacting a potential supervisor before applying is recommended but not required. The department confirms supervision after an offer of admission.

Graduate coordinator: grad-ece@northvale.invalid. Funding: see graduate funding. Calendar entry: MASc in ECE.

Master of Engineering (MEng)

A course-based professional degree, 12 to 16 months. Not thesis-based.
